title.zh: 终态分子总能量守恒诊断

summary: Compare the axial difference of a caller-owned total H2 heat-flux profile with the adjacent-cell mean of a caller-owned total energy-transfer profile.

identity.relation: source-defined normalized axial total-energy balance residual
identity.direction: axial positions, total H2 heat flux and total H2 energy transfer -> dimensionless nodal error profile
identity.definition: For each interval k from 0 through nx-2, q1[k]=(flux[k+1]-flux[k])/(x[k+1]-x[k]) and q2[k]=0.5*(transfer[k+1]+transfer[k]). Set q1[nx-1]=q2[nx-1]=0. Let N=max(abs(q1),abs(q2)) over both whole arrays; require N>0 and finite. Return abs(q1-q2)/N. The final zero is an endpoint convention, not a checked boundary equation. The global normalization can make an individual residual exceed one.
identity.model: saved KN1DPy terminal H2 total-energy profile diagnostic with caller-owned upstream profiles
identity.geometry: one-dimensional axial spatial mesh; one result per supplied node
identity.coordinates: adjacent axial positions in metres; no monotonicity requirement beyond nonzero adjacent spacing
identity.boundary: at least two finite aligned nodes; each adjacent represented spacing is finite and nonzero; signed flux and transfer are allowed; finite positive global normalization
assumptions: The caller supplies both total profiles on the same axial mesh. This leaf does not calculate heat flux, energy transfer or a terminal generation, and has no runtime dependency on their producers.

The named input units W/m^2 and W/m^3 give compatible axial derivative and transfer units when the upstream profile normalizations support those physical interpretations. The diagnostic alone does not verify them.
Boolean, complex and numeric-string coercions accepted by the saved implementation are excluded by the maintained real-numeric input contract.

inputs.name: axial_position_m
inputs.description: Axial nodes associated with both supplied profiles.
inputs.constraints: Finite one-dimensional profile with nx>=2 and finite nonzero adjacent represented differences; decreasing and locally nonmonotonic positions are accepted.

inputs.name: total_heat_flux_profile_w_m2
inputs.description: Caller-owned signed total axial H2 heat-flux profile.
inputs.constraints: Finite and exactly aligned with axial_position_m; no nonnegativity restriction.

inputs.name: total_energy_transfer_rate_profile_w_m3
inputs.description: Caller-owned signed total H2 energy-transfer rate profile.
inputs.constraints: Finite and exactly aligned with axial_position_m; no nonnegativity restriction.

outputs.name: total_energy_conservation_error_profile_dimensionless
outputs.description: Globally normalized absolute difference of the interval flux gradient and adjacent transfer mean, with zero at the final node by convention.
outputs.units: dimensionless on the supplied profile normalization
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; last element is exactly zero; individual entries can exceed one.

preconditions: Caller supplies aligned total heat-flux and energy-transfer profiles whose physical normalization and axial coordinate are compatible.
At least one represented interval gradient or adjacent transfer mean is nonzero so the global normalization is positive.
supported: Stateless source-defined discrete residual on finite signed profiles and nonzero adjacent axial spacings.
excluded: Terminal distribution or RHS production, boundary-flux closure, absolute physical validation, and any inference that a zero diagnostic establishes full transport conservation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-real numeric, non-finite, malformed or nonaligned profiles; fewer than two nodes; zero or non-finite represented adjacent spacing; or zero global normalization.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if the derived global normalization or output is non-finite; no partial mapping is returned.

example.description: A linear flux gradient equal to a constant transfer profile has zero source-defined residual.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import reduce_qh2_total_conservation_diagnostic
x = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 2.0])
r = reduce_qh2_total_conservation_diagnostic(x, np.array([0.0, 2.0, 4.0]), np.array([2.0, 2.0, 2.0]))
assert np.array_equal(r['total_energy_conservation_error_profile_dimensionless'], np.zeros(3))
example.expected: Three exact zero errors; the final zero is the endpoint convention.

scope: Independent interval slopes, adjacent transfer means and global normalization on signed nonuniform profiles; linear-balance and decreasing-grid witnesses.
Direct rejection tests cover shape, spacing, non-real inputs, zero normalization and non-finite derived gradient.
Three optional SHA-gated historical cases compare two finite carriers exactly and document boolean-coercion divergence.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct tests and optional saved replay establish this discrete diagnostic on tested profiles, not the upstream total profile normalization, full boundary balance, whole-source D1 qualification or expert approval.
known_limitations: The saved source's strict D1 qualification is withdrawn; replay is historical development evidence only.
Absolute physical meaning of the upstream total profiles and their unit labels requires expert review.
The final node is not independently checked and a zero error does not establish a complete conservation law.
